text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Mom and Dad, Sorry I haven't written much lately. I guess I've been worried about my friend City…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: I plucked up the courage to ask if she was okay… and I learned that even seemingly perfect Umamusume like her have their worries.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: Hoping to cheer her up, I told City that I was only able to stick it out this whole time because of my dream to be like her.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text: And I think I got through to her! Hopefully she'll have a bit more pep in her step now and run like she used to. And I'm gonna do my best too!
